title: Spatial and Figurative Alignment with mentén ('along / in alignment with')

sections.title: Literal Spatial Path: Along Boundaries and Rivers
sections.content: The spatial postposition mentén expresses position or movement parallel to an elongated feature (a river, a road, a coastline, or a boundary). The governed noun appears in the nominative: a folyó mentén ('along the river'), a határ mentén ('along the border'), az út mentén ('along the road').

sections.title: Figurative Extension in B2 Analytical Prose
sections.content: In formal Hungarian, mentén frequently introduces a guiding logic, principle, or methodological framework: ezen elvek mentén haladva ('proceeding along these principles'), a gazdasági érdekek mentén ('along the lines of economic interests').

sections.title: Literal and Figurative Collocations with mentén
rows: A Tisza mentén mezővárosok sora épült ki.
Along the Tisza, a chain of market towns was established.
A kereskedelmi útvonalak mentén áramlott a tőke.
Capital flowed along the trade routes.
A reformáció elvei mentén szervezték meg az oktatást.
Education was organized along the principles of the Reformation.
Világos célok mentén kell fejleszteni a régiót.
The region must be developed along clear objectives.

items.spanish: A régi kereskedelmi útvonal mentén gazdag mezővárosok virágoztak a hódoltság korában.
items.english: Along the ancient trade route, wealthy market towns flourished in the Ottoman era.

items.spanish: A város a puritán önigazgatás elvei mentén védte meg autonómiáját.
items.english: The town protected its autonomy along the principles of puritan self-governance.

items.spanish: A Duna mentén fekvő kikötők fontos szerepet játszottak a gabonaszállításban.
items.english: The ports lying along the Danube played an important role in grain transportation.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: The noun preceding mentén is never inflected: write 'a határ mentén', never 'a határon mentén'!
